name: XSURGE SurgeBNB sell() reentrancy
summary: SurgeToken.sell() sent BNB to the seller before updating the token supply and reserve, so the attacker's receive() hook re-entered purchase()/sell() repeatedly and drained the contract's BNB backing at a stale price.
notes: SurgeBNB is a direct, non-delegating contract. Its creation transaction deployed the runtime measured at the exploit, and that runtime remained unchanged through the exploit block.

The campaign report attributes five transactions and 13,112 BNB (about $5.57 million) to the same reentrancy campaign. It reports no recovery; the figure is gross and does not net any later compensation funded by the project.
The loss is a reported campaign aggregate rather than a separately repriced transaction-level asset ledger.
